promises.claim: What’s Missing names headshots first when you have none, since every submission starts with one.
promises.holds: `materialsCheck` lists the missing headshots first (src/engine/systems/pro.ts:882), and the Overview draws its list in that order.

promises.claim: Permission To Work on the Overview is the same permission Papers shows under Permission To Work.
promises.holds: The Overview's line is `eligibilityOf` (src/engine/systems/pro.ts:704), which reads `usWorkAuthorized`, as Papers does.

promises.claim: Your résumé uses your professional name, and one made under another name reads as behind.
promises.holds: A résumé is made under the professional name and keyed by it (src/engine/systems/pro.ts:786), so one under another name is behind.

promises.claim: Your special skills are your techniques on the Player Profile, at the level it shows.
promises.holds: `skillsOf` reads the craft's techniques at their levels (src/engine/systems/pro.ts:682).

promises.claim: Once you have headshots, What’s Missing stops asking for them, until they’re more than two years old.
promises.holds: `materialsCheck`: missing, then out of date past two years (src/engine/systems/pro.ts:883).

promises.claim: The session’s price comes out of your bank as a work cost.
promises.holds: `pro.headshots` spends through `spend` as a career cost (src/engine/systems/pro.ts:989).

promises.claim: Once you have a résumé, What’s Missing stops asking for one, until your record moves on past it.
promises.holds: `resumeBehind` (src/engine/systems/pro.ts:802), read by `materialsCheck`.

promises.claim: A School production’s part goes on your résumé once its run has closed.
promises.holds: `schoolCreditsOf` lists a run closed (src/engine/systems/pro.ts:658), which `resumeNow` adds.

promises.claim: A self-tape of a practice brief is the first recorded work a reel can be cut from.
promises.holds: `reelSources` offers a camera brief's takes (src/engine/systems/pro.ts:827).

promises.claim: Once you have a reel, What’s Missing stops asking for one, and says when newer work came after it.
promises.holds: `materialsCheck`: a missing reel, then newer work since it was cut (src/engine/systems/pro.ts:899).

promises.claim: A check refuses an approach with no headshots, since every submission starts with one.
promises.holds: `checkRefusal` refuses on the blocking materials (src/engine/systems/proagent.ts:537).

promises.claim: A check refuses an approach with no résumé, and a résumé behind your record is one thing his office can ask for.
promises.holds: The check's blocking résumé, and `requestable` lists a résumé behind (src/engine/systems/proagent.ts:429).

promises.claim: Sending your materials puts his office’s answer on the way, about ${TIME_WORDS.reply} on.
promises.holds: `pro.send_materials` puts the answer on the clock at `AGENT_TIMES.replyDays` (src/engine/systems/proagent.ts:1065).

promises.claim: A meeting kept or missed, and material sent when asked, are read under Reliability.
promises.holds: Reliability counts meetings kept and missed and material supplied or not (src/engine/systems/proagent.ts:374).

promises.claim: A meeting stops the clock like any commitment, and offers Ask To Move at the stop.
promises.holds: The meeting wants the player (`requiresPlayer`, src/engine/systems/proagent.ts:872) and its stop has Ask To Move (src/engine/systems/proagent.ts:980).

promises.claim: Your reel’s best band is part of Your Work, and a reel is part of Stage And Screen.
promises.holds: `workSeen` takes the reel's best band (src/engine/systems/proagent.ts:239), and the reel is screen work for Stage And Screen.

promises.claim: Each answer his office gives keeps its reasons here.
promises.holds: `keepWhy` copies each decision's reasons in (src/engine/systems/proagent.ts:447).

promises.claim: Signing with him gives no permission to work: Papers, under Permission To Work, still says what you may do.
promises.holds: `usWorkAuthorized` reads no agreement (src/engine/systems/permission.ts:115).

promises.claim: Accepting, declining and the agreement’s end each go in History With His Office.
promises.holds: Accepted, declined and ended are each noted in his history (src/engine/systems/proagent.ts:1119, src/engine/systems/proagent.ts:1135, src/engine/systems/proagent.ts:1259).

promises.claim: Each payment lands in your account on its payday, or from your agency’s trust account a few business days later.
promises.holds: `payDue` posts to the payee account or the trust account (src/engine/systems/propay.ts:469), `release` on from it (src/engine/systems/propay.ts:520).

promises.claim: Your tax return reads each payment’s wages, withholding, commission, dues and the town the work was done in.
promises.holds: `payDue` reports through `recordWages` with the employer, withholding, commission, dues and town (src/engine/systems/propay.ts:497), which the return reads.

promises.claim: Each engagement’s dates are read against your permission to work when you book it.
promises.holds: `schedulePay` keeps `eligibilityRead` for the dates (src/engine/systems/propay.ts:555); acceptance reads `usWorkAuthorized` for each day.

promises.claim: Commission comes off your pay as it passes through your agency’s trust account.
promises.holds: `release` posts the commission off what the trust account holds (src/engine/systems/propay.ts:528).

promises.claim: The year’s commission counts toward the performing artist’s deduction the return works out.
promises.holds: The pay records the commission into the year (src/engine/systems/earnings.ts:187), and the return's deduction takes commission and dues (src/engine/systems/taxreturn.ts:960).
promises.why: Each link is tested: tests/propay.test.ts reads a played payment's commission in the year, and tests/safetynet.test.ts the deduction from wages recorded by hand. No test plays a career's commission through to a return's deduction: it needs two qualifying employers in a year, which no played life here has had.

promises.claim: Each union bill comes out of your bank on its day.

promises.claim: Your résumé lists your unions once you’re a member.
promises.holds: `resumeNow` lists each union a member of (src/engine/systems/pro.ts:789).

promises.claim: Dues count toward the cost of your work on the year’s return.

promises.why: Each link is tested: tests/propay.test.ts reads the working dues in the year and tests/b20-career-defects.test.ts the fee and the dues paid from the bank, both played; tests/safetynet.test.ts the deduction from wages recorded by hand. No test plays a career through to a return's deduction, which needs two qualifying employers in a year. Until brief 20 only the working dues reached the year (a defect, repaired).

promises.claim: A submission starts with your headshots: without them it can’t be sent.

promises.claim: A submission puts the casting office’s answer on the clock, and the answer sets an audition.
promises.holds: A submission puts casting's answer on the clock (src/engine/systems/projobs.ts:967), which sets the round.

promises.claim: Casting reads your audition’s band, with the role’s fit and the field, when it decides whether to offer you the role.

promises.claim: An audition in person goes on your calendar with its trip, and stops the clock when it comes.

promises.claim: An offer can be accepted only where your permission to work covers every one of its days.
promises.holds: `acceptRefusal` reads `usWorkAuthorized` for every day (src/engine/systems/projobs.ts:851).

promises.claim: The part goes on your professional credits, and your résumé reads as behind until it has it.

promises.claim: Accepting puts each work day on your calendar, and each stops the clock for you.

promises.claim: Work in term without approval moves your standing to academic warning, and a second time to dismissal.
promises.holds: `reportUnapproved` steps the standing (src/engine/systems/projobs.ts:1278).

promises.claim: An offer in term is accepted on the School’s approval, or against it with the warning said first.

promises.claim: How each scene went at each showcase day stays on your professional record.
